title: Linguist invoices, with a Finance queue to approve and pay them
summary: Linguists invoice their own work and Finance approves and pays it, tasks link to any process, and projects link single Assets files.

sections.title: Linguist invoices
sections.note: Linguists invoice the work they did, and Finance approves and pays it.

items.body: Preview and send an invoice for your work from **My invoices**
Approve, reject or mark invoices paid in **Finance**
Approve or mark many invoices paid at once
Download any invoice as a PDF
A new **Finance** role for the people who handle invoices

sections.title: Link more work into projects
sections.note: Bring a process or a single file into a project without copying it.

items.body: Link a process from any galaxy to a task you made by hand
Link single Assets files to a project, not only directories
Linked files and directories are pinned at the top of **Files**
Projects: locked actions show a lock and the reason
Projects: open a task's file straight from the task
Projects: deleting a project cancels its open runs
Quality: a report with findings but no words shows as not scored
Translation Memory: CSV exports are safe to open in spreadsheets
Translation Memory: English to English (UK) and other regional pairs are localised
Translation Memory: right-to-left text displays correctly
Glossaries and term bases: Excel imports find the right sheet and keep dates
Projects: language picks save reliably and no longer flash back
Time: a deleted task's timer keeps its time on the project
